usedFor: humanitix sells event tickets and Brevo mails the audience, so “New Attendes” can feed “Add Contacts To List”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Attendes” in humanitix, then “Add Contacts To List” in Brevo
bestTemplate.why: It runs for every attendee on an order, so each guest is added, not only the buyer.

watchOut: “Add Contacts To List” takes existing contacts, so a new attendee must already exist in Brevo.
